tasks.title: Hosted Bench passes with measured temporary api and notify test CPU floors
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, Preconditions, steps 1-5, Checks and Completion evidence; Required behavior 3-5; Counterexamples (rounding, median, api budget/floor and notify verdicts); Rollout order; Risks; Acceptance evidence 3-4. Keep R1, its derived budget/floor edits, temporary-floor documentation and R2 in this single task. Check merged #617 and merged probe/status children before any change or measurement; hold if missing. Follow every step-2 hold condition and hold on R2 failure without widening values. No release tags, thresholdPct changes or production/harness/CI changes.

acceptance.command: gh issue view 617 --repo lorenzh/pulse-meta --json state,body,comments && gh pr view <617-api-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json mergedAt,mergeCommit && git merge-base --is-ancestor <617-api-merge-sha> origin/main && gh pr view <probe-child-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe --json mergedAt,mergeCommit && gh pr view <status-child-pr> --repo lorenzh/pulse-status --json mergedAt,mergeCommit
acceptance.expected: Before changing files or starting R1: #617 is CLOSED, its API PR is merged into origin/main (ancestor command exit 0), and both #585 probe/status children are merged into their main branches. Confirm the child merge SHAs are ancestors of their current main heads. If any precondition fails, request needs-input naming it; especially stop if #617 has not merged after probe/status finish.

acceptance.command: gh workflow run bench.yml --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --ref main
acceptance.expected: R1 is a hosted, default-input, 5-round A/B measurement on API main containing #617 and probe/status main containing the child changes. Identify and watch this dispatch, download its bench-out artifact and read table.json and resolved refs. An exit-1 gating failure on api/notify test_cpu_s is expected and supplies the measurements; a harness error is not acceptable. Record R1 run URL and api/notify/probe/status A/B medians from this one run.

acceptance.command: gh run view <R1-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run download <R1-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir <R1-artifact-directory>
acceptance.expected: Before edits, R1 shows probe test_cpu_s B at most 2.3 s, status B at most 2.4 s, notify B at most 2.5 s and notify B-A at most 0.6 s. With ceil0.1(x)=Math.ceil(x*10-1e-9)/10, ceil0.1(api A*1.3) is at least api B+0.1 s. No other gating row fails. If any condition fails or the harness errors, request needs-input with the measurements instead of changing other rows or widening the prescribed values.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && git diff --name-only <base-sha> HEAD && git diff <base-sha> HEAD -- bench/budgets.json bench/README.md
acceptance.expected: exit 0; exactly bench/budgets.json and bench/README.md change. notify.test_cpu_s has budget 2.5, unit s, gating true and floor 0.6. api.test_cpu_s keeps unit s and gating true; budget is ceil0.1(R1 api A median*1.3), floor is ceil0.1(R1 api B median-R1 api A median+0.2), using the same independent hosted R1 table.json. For A=3.76/B=4.66 the values are 4.9/1.1, never 6.1. Every other budget entry remains byte-for-byte unchanged; no thresholdPct changes. Under Initial budgets, Temporary test floors documents R1 URL, notify/api A/B medians, formulas/results, accepted notify growth from #588/#594/#605/#607 and API #561/#617 against v0.1.0. It says release tags remain an owner decision and the first API PR after each repo's next v* tag removes that repo's floor and resets its budget from new A*1.3 rounded up to 0.1 s. Contract/config floor text stays unchanged.
exit 0; repository lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with the existing coverage gate.
exit 0; every check-*.ts self-test in the script passes, including check-budgets: ok.
exit 0; the existing benchmark Compose configuration validates. The full hosted R2 exercises this Compose stack end to end.

R2 dispatches the pushed PR branch with no a, b or others inputs, using its changed budgets and main for B. Identify/watch this dispatch and inspect its bench-out artifact. Conclusion success, bench exit 0, no harness error, no FAIL row and every gating row ok, including probe B at most 2.3 s and status B at most 2.4 s. If any row fails, including kit, request needs-input with the failing rows; do not widen values beyond the spec.

acceptance.command: gh run view <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json conclusion,url && gh run view <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run download <R2-run-id> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir <R2-artifact-directory> && gh pr checks <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api && gh pr view <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-api --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: R2 conclusion is success and all required PR CI checks pass. PR body gives R1/R2 URLs, resolved API B SHA containing #617 and probe/status B SHAs containing their child merges, a table of A/B medians and verdicts for every R2 test_cpu_s row, arithmetic from R1 for both API values, checks/results and the kit risk (previous B 0.672 s against 0.7 s). It records the post-merge handoff: the person merging verifies the first nightly Bench on API main concludes success with #617 merged, and posts its run URL and test_cpu_s A/B medians on #585. This nightly remains feature acceptance, after the pre-merge R2 check.
